 * Check that the cup is suitable for use in the microwave. Metal decorative elements can cause sparks. 4. Dishwasher safe:
 * Make sure the mug is dishwasher safe. Some materials and designs can be destroyed. 5. Use by children:
 * Children should use cups under adult supervision, especially with hot drinks. 6. Stability:
 * Set the cup on a stable surface to avoid tipping over and spilling the drink. 7. Materials:
 * People with allergies should check the material composition of the cup to avoid allergic reactions. 8. Cleaning:
 * Clean the cup regularly to prevent the growth of bacteria and mold. 9. Condition Checking:
 * Regularly inspect the cup for cracks, nicks, and other damage. 10. Safe use:
 * Do not use the cup for purposes other than intended, e.g. as a container for chemicals. 11. Thermal Mugs:
 * For thermal mugs, make sure they are tightly closed to avoid leaks. 12. Warnings for specific materials:
 * Plastic cups: Avoid high temperatures that can cause the release of harmful substances. Melamine cups: Do not use in the microwave, as melamine can release harmful compounds under the influence of heat.

safetyInformation.description:
List of plate safety warnings based on the requirements of General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988 (GPSR):

1. Risk of cuts:
 * Beware of sharp edges, especially in case of breakage or damage to the plate. * Do not use chipped or cracked plates. 2. Stability and rollover:
 * Make sure the plates are stable on the surface on which they are placed to avoid tipping them over. * Do not put too many plates on top of each other. 3. Temperature resistance:
 * Do not heat food on the plate in the oven unless the plate is intended for this purpose. * Beware of sudden temperature changes. 4. Microwave safety:
 * Check that the plates are suitable for use in the microwave. Plates with decorations are not always suitable for microwave. 5. Materials:
 * Plates may contain harmful chemicals, so use only certified products * Choose plates without harmful substances. 6. Plates for children:
 * Plates for children should be unbreakable and made of safe materials. * Children's plates should not contain small elements that could be swallowed. 7. Dishwasher safe:
 * Make sure the plates are dishwasher safe. Some plates may be damaged at high temperatures or under the influence of detergents. 8. Cleaning and Maintenance:
 * Clean plates with gentle means. * Do not use corrosive cleaners that can damage the surface. 9. Storage:
 * Store plates in a dry and safe place. Avoid places that are prone to falls. 10. Usage:
 * Never use plates for any purpose. Plate is used for eating meals. 11. Disposal:
 * Remember to segregate waste and properly dispose of damaged plates. * Take advantage of your local PSZOK.
